create_user_with_sqlite_repository: create a new user record using the SQLiteUserRepository with email and password hash
get_user_by_email_sqlite: retrieve a user from the SQLite repository by their email address
update_user_fields_sqlite: update user fields like password hash or system role in the SQLite repository
count_admin_users_sqlite: count the number of admin users stored in the SQLite database
get_user_by_oauth_sqlite: find a user by their OAuth provider and OAuth ID in the SQLite repository
